title: Bookkeeper
description:
Sophia at Avocet Legal Careers is pleased to be working with a well-established organisation seeking an experienced Bookkeeper to join its finance support team.

This is a part-time, home-based opportunity offering flexibility, autonomy and regular travel across Cornwall.

About the Client

Our client is a respected organisation with a widespread presence across Cornwall. They support a network of sites throughout the county and are committed to delivering a high standard of financial management and operational support. The organisation offers a welcoming culture, flexible working arrangements and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution within a varied and people-focused role.

About the Role

Working from home for 28 hours per week, you will take responsibility for maintaining accurate financial records across a portfolio of locations. The position combines bookkeeping, reporting, stakeholder support and occasional compliance monitoring. Regular travel throughout Cornwall is required, with mileage paid from home at 55p per mile, paid travel time and a monthly car allowance of 80.

Bookkeeper Responsibilities
- Maintaining accurate bookkeeping records for multiple sites using cloud-based finance systems
- Processing income and expenditure transactions and reconciling bank accounts
- Monitoring financial records and following up on missing information where required
- Producing year-end financial information and supporting reporting processes
- Providing guidance and practical support to stakeholders responsible for local finances
- Delivering training and assistance on financial processes and record-keeping requirements
- Assisting with reviews, audits and compliance checks across various locations
- Responding to finance-related queries and building positive working relationships across the organisation

Bookkeeper Requirements
- AAT qualification, part-qualified status or equivalent bookkeeping experience
- Previous experience in a bookkeeping or finance support position
- Strong numerical accuracy and excellent attention to detail
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Confident communication skills with the ability to support a range of stakeholders
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Comfortable working independently and managing your own workload
- Full driving licence and access to your own vehicle
- Willingness to travel regularly throughout Cornwall

Benefits
- Salary of 27,503.84 per annum
- Home-based working
- 28-hour working week
- 20 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays (pro rata)
- Additional time off during the Christmas period
- Company pension scheme
- Death in Service benefit
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Cashback and employee discount scheme

The Ideal Candidate

You will be an experienced and dependable bookkeeping professional who enjoys combining financial accuracy with stakeholder support. You'll be comfortable managing your own workload, travelling regularly across Cornwall and building trusted relationships with people at all levels.

For a confidential discussion about this opportunity, please contact Sophia at Avocet Legal Careers.

title: Administrator
description:
Plant & Parts Administrator

Location: Redruth
Salary: 25,000 - 28,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 - 17:00

We are seeking an organised and proactive Plant & Parts Administrator to join our busy team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills and an interest in stock control, plant, fleet, or stores management.

Working as part of the Plant Department, you will play a key role in ensuring parts, tools, and equipment are accurately managed and readily available to support operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the day-to-day management and organisation of the plant and parts stores.
- Monitor, track, and record stock levels, including plant parts, tools, and fleet-related items.
- Maintain accurate inventory records and update internal databases and management systems.
- Support the implementation and continuous improvement of stock-control and parts-management systems.
- Assist with ordering, receiving, checking, and storing parts and equipment.
- Liaise with site teams to understand requirements and ensure parts and equipment are available when needed.
- Communicate with suppliers and colleagues to support the efficient movement and distribution of stock.
- Carry out regular stock checks and investigate discrepancies.
- Maintain an organised stores environment, ensuring all items are correctly labelled, recorded, and stored.
- Provide general administrative support to the Plant Department, including data entry, filing, and record management.
- Support the wider team with additional duties as required.

About You
- Previous experience in an administrative, stores, stock control, plant, fleet, or parts environment would be advantageous.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and internal computer systems.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively.
- Good communication skills with the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues and suppliers.
- Accurate data entry and record-keeping skills.
- A proactive and flexible approach to work.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of 25,000 - 30,000, depending on experience.
- Full-time, permanent position.
- Monday to Friday working hours with no weekend work.
- Opportunity to join a supportive and growing team.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.

If you are an organised administrator looking for a varied role where you can make a real impact within a busy Plant Department, we'd love to hear from you. For more information or to apply for this Plant & Parts Administrator position, please contact Louise Fletcher, Berry Recruitment, on (phone number removed).

title: Payroll Clerk
description:
The Opportunity

An established UK-based business is looking for a highly motivated, adaptable and organised Payroll & Timesheet Controller to join its Finance Team.

This is a newly created role offering the opportunity to take ownership of payroll administration and timesheet processes across the organisation.

Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring accurate and efficient payroll processing, maintaining employee records and supporting the wider Finance and HR functions.

The successful candidate will be proactive, numerate and comfortable working to tight deadlines, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage their own workload.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing accurate weekly and monthly payroll.
- Taking ownership of the company-wide timesheet database, including subcontractors.
- Checking timesheets to ensure all information is complete and accurate.
- Chasing outstanding or late timesheet submissions.
- Processing weekly and monthly pension submissions and reconciling these against the accounts.
- Liaising with operational teams to ensure all working hours are accurately captured and reported.
- Working with department managers on payroll-related matters, including salary increases, new starters and banked hours/TOIL.
- Supporting the development and improvement of internal processes and procedures.
- Reviewing employee benefits, including Benefits in Kind (BIK), holiday entitlements and banked hours.
- Providing administrative support to HR and Finance, including preparation for annual audits.

About You

You will ideally have previous payroll and administration experience, with the confidence to manage a varied workload independently.

We're looking for someone who has:
- Strong numerical and organisational skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills and the confidence to liaise with colleagues across different departments.
- A proactive approach and the ability to use initiative.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Experience using payroll software, ideally SAGE Payroll.

Desirable experience:
- Timesheet management.
- Pension administration.
- Benefits in Kind (BIK) and other HMRC payroll-related processes.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary of £28,000 - £32,000 per annum.
- Full-time hours, Monday to Friday, typically 9am-5pm.
- Some flexibility around working hours to suit workload requirements.
- 28 days annual leave, including bank holidays.
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

Interested?

If you have payroll experience and are looking for an opportunity to take ownership of payroll and timesheet processes within an established business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Client Bookkeeper
description:
Part-Time Client Bookkeeper - Falmouth - £30,000 - £35,000 FTE

A great opportunity for an experienced Client Bookkeeper to join a friendly and supportive accountancy practice in Falmouth.

This is a well-established Cornish accountancy practice, that places real importance on delivering a quality service to its clients and creating a positive working environment for its team. They are looking to recruit a Part-Time Client Bookkeeper to support a varied portfolio of clients, with flexibility and on-going development forming part of the opportunity.

This is a varied, client-facing role where the successful candidate will take responsibility for maintaining accurate financial records, preparing VAT returns and dealing directly with clients on a regular basis.

Key responsibilities of this Part-Time Client Bookkeeper position will include:
- Maintaining accurate bookkeeping records for a varied portfolio of clients
- Preparing VAT returns and ensuring submissions are completed accurately and within relevant deadlines
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain financial information and resolve bookkeeping queries
- Processing invoices, receipts and other financial documents using a range of accounting software.
- Working closely with colleagues across the wider accounts team to ensure work is completed efficiently.

The successful Part-Time Client Bookkeeper will have:

Previous practical bookkeeping experience gained within an accountancy practice, alongside a good understanding of VAT returns and associated compliance requirements.

Confidence using accounting software packages such as Sage, Xero or QuickBooks will be important, as will strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines. Good communication skills and a friendly, professional approach to client relationships are also key.

If you're an experienced Client Bookkeeper looking for a part-time role where you can build strong client relationships within an established local practice, please apply quoting reference JVS11367, or contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith for a confidential discussion.

title: Accounts Assistant

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Butler Rose is delighted to be recruiting for an Accounts Assistant on behalf of a well-established and innovative international business based in Saltash. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional looking to join a collaborative team environment where they can take ownership of the purchase ledger function while gaining broader exposure across transactional finance and management accounting.

This role would suit a candidate working towards AAT, or someone with equivalent practical experience, who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and thrives on accuracy, organisation, and building strong working relationships.

The Role

Working within a supportive finance team, you will take responsibility for the purchase ledger function while providing wider support across the finance department.

Key responsibilities include:
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes through Sage and Paperless systems.
- Reconciling supplier statements on a monthly basis.
- Preparing and processing BACS supplier payment runs.
- Managing foreign currency payment runs.
- Processing ad hoc bank payments.
- Maintaining the accounts and Paperless inboxes.
- Downloading and posting company credit card transactions.
- Processing overseas branch expenses.
- Supporting sales ledger activities, including bank reconciliations, cashflow updates, expense claims, VAT returns, and credit control.
- Assisting with management accounts preparation and month-end reconciliations.
- Providing support with additional finance-related tasks as required.

About You

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
- Working towards AAT qualification or equivalent accounting experience.
- Previous experience working within a finance or accounts environment.
- Knowledge of Sage Accounts, ideally Sage 200.
- Strong Excel skills with experience in reporting and data manipulation.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to liaise confidently with suppliers and colleagues.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- A proactive, flexible, and positive approach to work.
- High levels of accuracy, discretion, and attention to detail.

Benefits

The business offers an attractive benefits package including:
- 5 weeks annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Employer pension contribution of 5%.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Free on-site parking.
- Enhanced leave and sickness benefits linked to service.
- Weekly and monthly incentive raffles.
- Early finish every Friday.

Please note that applicants must have the right to work in the UK, as visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Successful candidates will also be subject to referencing and vetting checks.
